bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money to rehabilitate the Salisbury Bridge.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SALISBURY BRIDGE IN MEEKER COUNTY.

$1,650,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the governing board of the Minnesota Historical Society for one or more grants to Kingston Township, Forest City Township, or both, to plan and complete the rehabilitation of the Salisbury Bridge in Meeker County.
